items.article_text:
Post oficial de @pearljam no Instagram (IMAGE), 2026-11-11T15:00:37+0000.

Legenda original:
This Veterans Day, we pause to recognize and honor all who have served and the sacrifices veterans and their families make. We are grateful for the many ways they continue to contribute to their communities.

Today, we also remember Tomas Young, who was wounded and paralyzed while serving in Iraq. In the years that followed, Tomas became a passionate advocate for peace and justice. We continue to honor his life and legacy through the Tomas Young Scholarship, supporting veterans and their families in pursuing higher education.

📸: Kevin Mazur

Yesterday, Mike McCready made the title track and video for his project, Farewell To Seasons, available to the Fan Club. Unfortunately, there's no video available to non-members, but the official release date is December 1st, so that will be coming soon.

We did, however, get a list of the musicians and engineers working on the album.

Mike McCready (vocals, guitar, backing vocals), Josh Evans (bass, piano, additional guitar), Mike Musburger (drums), Molly Sides (backing vocals)

Josh Evans (producer, recording and mixing), John Goodmanson (producer), Mike McCready (writer, producer, recording), Ed Brooks (mastering), John Goodmanson (recording), Nate Yaccino (recording), Floyd Reitsma (assistant engineer), Jon Roberts (assistant engineer)

You can still pick up the book and album in surprising places, so if you haven't ordered a copy, keep looking.
